Greta is a data Maestro

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency by Vehicle Weight",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per gallon",
    color = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
